staff: Turns a request ('Design a 40-storey mixed-use tower in Sydney') into a structured brief: use, scale, site, jurisdiction, performance targets, budget, programme, client values, and an explicit list of UNKNOWNs and questions for the client.
Breaks the brief into engineering tasks with owners, inputs, outputs, analysis level (PROTOCOL.md §3) and definition of done; writes the work breakdown.
Maps each task to the right division agent and sub-specialty focus using architecture/org.json; flags tasks no agent covers.
Orders tasks by data dependency (site and ground before foundations, structure before façade loads), finds what can run in parallel, and detects circular dependencies that need an iteration loop.
Runs design → simulate → evaluate → modify loops: what changed between iterations, convergence criteria, iteration limits, and which results are invalidated by a change.

Keeps the single list of hard constraints (codes, strength, serviceability, drift, vibration, fire, accessibility, planning, budget, geometry) with their source class and value, and checks every option against it.
Records decisions with options considered, criteria, evidence, who decided (human or agent), and what would reopen them; prepares decisions that must go to a human.

Resolves clashes between disciplines (duct vs beam, glazing vs overheating, cost vs carbon) by stating the trade-off, quantifying each side, and recommending; never resolves a conflict by relaxing a safety constraint.

Maintains architecture/memory/: assumptions register, facts with sources, decisions, lessons and known errors, so later agents start from the project's record instead of re-deriving or contradicting it.
Tracks every deliverable (reports, models, drawings, schedules, IFC, pages), its status, version, reviewer and whether it passed the return-format validator and Safety/QA gate.

leads.bld-project-lead: Project Agent: scope, programme, cost, procurement, construction, transport.
leads.bld-design-lead: Design Agent: architecture and engineering design integration.
leads.bld-safety-qa-lead: Safety / QA Agent: life safety, codes, accessibility, risk, critique and independent verification; holds the issue gate.

divisions.name: Architecture
divisions.rules: Always generate several alternatives before recommending one, each optimised for a named objective, e.g. Option A cheapest, Option B lowest carbon, Option C maximum usable floor area, Option D best daylight, Option E strongest architectural identity. Hand the option set with its metrics to `bld-optimisation-agent` (non-dominated comparison: `python architecture/tools/pareto.py`).

divisions.name: Structural Engineering
divisions.rules: Run as analysis × material × element focus (e.g. `focus: Buckling / Mass Timber / Column`). Every governing result needs an independent check through `bld-independent-verifier` and `architecture/tools/verify_compare.py`. Tools: OpenSeesPy, Gmsh + CalculiX, Code_Aster (skills bld-opensees-modelling, bld-fe-gmsh-calculix, bld-code-aster-advanced).

divisions.name: Earthquake Engineering
divisions.rules: Pipeline, never text-only seismic numbers: Earthquake agent → generates OpenSees model → OpenSees simulation → `bld-results-interpreter` → independent seismic review (`bld-independent-verifier` + `verify_compare.py`). Reference implementation: `python architecture/seismic/pipeline.py`. Hazard values only from the jurisdiction's official source.

divisions.name: Geotechnical Engineering
divisions.rules: Consume actual geotechnical investigation data (borehole logs, SPT, CPT, lab results). If none exists, return the investigation scope and mark every soil parameter UNKNOWN; never invent soil properties.

divisions.name: Foundation Engineering
divisions.rules: Evaluate the alternatives and compare them on settlement, bearing capacity, uplift, lateral forces, seismic effects, cost, constructability and embodied carbon; use `architecture/tools/pareto.py` for the comparison. Capacities only from investigation data.

divisions.name: Wind Engineering
divisions.rules: Critical for towers. Detailed CFD via OpenFOAM (not installed here: see skill bld-eng-stack-setup); CFD supplements but does not replace code methods or wind-tunnel testing for tall or unusual buildings.

divisions.name: Mechanical / HVAC
divisions.rules: Smoke control is designed with `bld-fire-life-safety`, whose verdict governs.

divisions.name: Building Energy
divisions.rules: Pipeline: Architect agent → building geometry → Energy agent → EnergyPlus → annual simulation → `bld-optimisation-agent` → back to Architect + HVAC agents. EnergyPlus is not installed in this container; until it is, return method and inputs only and mark energy results UNKNOWN.

divisions.name: Fire Engineering
divisions.rules: Operate conservatively. Every check concludes with exactly one of: PASS, FAIL, INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION, PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Never 'probably safe' or any hedged equivalent; the return-format validator rejects it.

divisions.name: BIM
divisions.rules: The BIM model is the central digital representation of the building. Standards: IFC (IFC 4.3 is the current official buildingSMART release and covers infrastructure; the coordination model here is IFC4 and should move to IFC4X3 when site and civil works are modelled), BCF for issues, IDS for information requirements, openBIM throughout.

divisions.name: Open-source BIM engine
divisions.rules: Engine, not an agent: used by the BIM division through `architecture/bim/make_ifc.py`, `requirements_ids.py` and `calculations/takeoff_reconcile.py`.

divisions.name: Codes
divisions.rules: Do not rely on remembered codes; standards change. Pipeline: user specifies jurisdiction → retrieve the current standard (edition and date) → extract applicable clauses → express as compliance rules → run design checks → cite evidence. Classify every requirement as LAW, BUILDING CODE, REFERENCED STANDARD, GUIDANCE, PROJECT SPECIFICATION, CLIENT REQUIREMENT or ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION. Without a retrieved current text, the result is INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION.

divisions.name: Optimisation
divisions.rules: Objectives such as: minimise construction cost, embodied carbon, energy, structural weight; maximise rentable area, daylight, structural robustness, constructability. Subject to hard constraints from `bld-constraint-manager`: codes, strength, serviceability, drift, vibration, fire, accessibility, budget, geometry, planning rules. Loop: design → simulation → evaluate → modify → repeat (with `bld-iteration-manager`). Tools: pymoo, `architecture/tools/pareto.py`. Cross-check every optimum (brute force, multiple seeds) and keep margin off active safety constraints.

divisions.name: Engineering Critic
subs: What if the soil stiffness estimate is wrong?
What happens if one column disappears?
What happens in an earthquake beyond design level?
Where could humans misuse the building?
divisions.rules: Never designs anything. Attacks designs: every question above gets an answer or an explicit UNKNOWN, and every credible mechanism becomes CAUSE · MECHANISM · CONSEQUENCE · DETECTION · MITIGATION · RESIDUAL RISK.

divisions.name: Independent Verification
divisions.rules: Never let the same model generate and approve a calculation. Engineer agent A → solution; independent agent B → independent calculation by a different method, without seeing A's numbers; agent C compares (`python architecture/tools/verify_compare.py a.json b.json --tol tol.json`). Difference < tolerance → PROCEED; difference > tolerance → INVESTIGATE.
